answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A vault of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ripple of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
